title: Allow very long descriptions without truncation (gallery + other description fields)

requirements.text: Update all gallery image description displays to support very long text without being cut off. Remove any UI truncation (e.g., Tailwind `line-clamp-*`) and ensure descriptions wrap across multiple lines (use word-breaking and preserve line breaks where relevant). This applies to: public gallery cards, admin gallery management cards, and featured gallery cards.

quotes: Saya ingin di tiap2 deskripsi nya muat kalimat banyak tak terbatas  jangan terlalu pendek muat kata2 nya

acceptanceCriteria: Gallery descriptions are no longer limited to 2 lines anywhere they are displayed.
Very long descriptions render fully (multi-line) without being visually cut off.
Long unbroken strings do not overflow the card layout (they wrap/break safely).

requirements.text: Ensure all description editing inputs support long, multi-sentence text comfortably. Use multiline inputs everywhere descriptions are edited and ensure there is no client-side `maxLength` or other artificial limit that prevents long descriptions from being entered and saved.
acceptanceCriteria: Admins can paste/type long descriptions (multiple paragraphs) into description fields and save successfully.
No description input field enforces a small/short maximum length via the UI.

constraints: Do not edit files in frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Do not change authentication, roles, or admin gating behavior.
Do not redesign unrelated sections (services pricing, contact, theme) beyond what is necessary to display long descriptions.
